services.name: Sky River Rush
services.desc: Experience the thrill of this "Air to Water Combo" as Scenic Helicopter Tours partners with Smoky Mountain Jet Boat to bring you an extraordinary package that combines the beauty of the skies with the excitement of the water. Start your adventure with a private helicopter ride provided by Scenic Helicopter Tours, where you'll take off for a breathtaking 12-mile flight. Glide over the French Broad River, Douglas Lake, and the impressive Douglas Dam, all while enjoying the stunning views of East Tennessee's rolling hills and picturesque mountain landscapes from 1500 feet above ground.
